shortDescription: A browser for Android TV with ad blocking, private tabs and remote controls.
fullDescription:
Rhenium brings everyday web browsing to Android TV and Google TV. Built on Brave and Chromium, it combines a native TV interface with ad blocking, private tabs and controls designed for your remote.

BROWSE WITH YOUR REMOTE
Move between links, buttons and text fields using the D-pad. Keep moving at the visible edge to scroll. Press OK to activate an item or open the keyboard. Hold OK to switch between element navigation and a pointer.

A HOME FOR YOUR TV
Start with scenic backgrounds, a prominent search bar, editable favorites and shortcuts to open pages. Find tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads and page controls in the TV browser menu.

DOWNLOAD FILES AND APKS
Save files from websites. After downloading an APK, choose Open file in Downloads to open Android's package installer. You approve installation from Rhenium and confirm the installation in Android.

AD AND TRACKER BLOCKING
Brave Shields blocks ads and trackers using packaged filter rules and signed filter updates. Use the native site protection controls to turn protection off or back on for a particular website.

PRIVATE BROWSING
Open private tabs and keep normal saved and recent pages out of private Home. Private browsing does not make your activity anonymous to websites or your network provider.

OPTIONAL PHONE CONTROLS
Connect your phone on the same trusted local network to enter text and control browsing, with approval on the TV. Phone controls currently use unencrypted local HTTP.

Rhenium is an open-source browser licensed under MPL 2.0. Source code, release notes and issue reporting are available at https://github.com/smolcars/rhenium. Built with thanks to the contributors to Brave, Chromium and their open-source dependencies.

Website playback and protected streaming support depend on the website and device; availability of a service is not guaranteed. Rhenium is an independent browser and is not affiliated with the websites in its editable starter favorites.
